Now reborn just days before her marriage, Amelia refuses to be a pawn again. She’ll rewrite fate—even if it means stepping into the darkness.

This time, two powerful men stand in her way—and in her heart. The Alpha King who once died for her... and the mysterious stranger who claims her soul. On her eighteenth birthday, both stake their claim—and neither is willing to let go.
---
“You swore loyalty. Prove it—with your love, and your body.”
—The Alpha King, before crashing his lips against her throat and pushing her onto the bed.
“You saved my life. Now this body is yours. And I take care of what’s mine.…
reincarnated-as-a-princesss-pet-with-tra:
Max died right after beating an impossible level in his favorite RPG, Eldoria's Entry 3.
That should have been the end.
Instead, he woke up inside the game.
In a world where humans do not exist, Max reincarnated as one.
With miserable stats and no way to grow like a normal adventurer, he was labeled completely useless from the start.
His only saving grace was a unique Rank-SSS skill.
Unfortunately, he didn’t really understand how it worked.
Before he could figure out how to survive, Max opened his eyes inside a royal castle.
It was an elven princess’s birthday.
And he was her new pet.
----------------------------------------------
What To Expect:
-NEW CHAPTERS ALL DAYS
-A system that isn’t always well explained
-Humor of all kinds.
-No harem
-No R18.
-OP MC.
-Slice of life moments to slow things down.
-Adventure moments filled with danger and tough choices.
seraphinas-revenge-a-rebirth-in-the-apoc:
Zombie Apocalypse? Been there, done that. Got the mutation inside of her to prove it.
Seraphina made a wish, a chance to die human and be reborn a year before the world ended. She thought that if she could just go back to the life she had before, to the body she had before, then everything would be fine.
That was what she was promised when the lab burned down. That was what she was expecting.
But wishes never go the way you wanted them to. Instead of having a seed inside of her to keep her safe, Sera brought back the creature that had been trying to take over her body.
And it was stronger than ever before.
When the apocalypse came this time around, it wasn't the zombies she had to worry about. Blizzards, a new ice age, shifting temperatures, and a summer from hell were all become part of the course for the inhabitants of Country N. But when she tried to help a friend, secrets that should never have been exposed come to the surface.
She told them that she was just lucky. That it really wasn't as heavy as it appeared, that it really wasn't as far as it appeared, that she really wasn't as purple as she appeared, she lied.…
spoiled-by-the-president-my-wife-is-a-li:
Her boyfriend and her sister tangled together in the sheets, so she turned around and married the fearsome business tycoon, Gideon Leith.
Not only is she a star in her own right, but she's also a publicist and an entrepreneur?
A super racecar driver? A worldrenown gold medalist designer too?!
Just who is this precious hidden treasure of a girl!!!
She went from being pitifully spurned to a goddess looked up to by tens of thousands of people, and her admirers queued from Jincheng all the way to Kyoto.
Mr. Leith, who saw a certain someone's feminine charm, quickly tucked her into his arms.
“Wife, I need to hide you well. You can only belong to me!”
supremely-talented-tyrant:
A man who had emerged from the world’s most secure prison—God of Death Island, known as a super-powered being called the God of Death, had grown tired of the bloody storms abroad and now, like a hidden dragon, he had returned!
But due to an accident, he became the contract husband of a beautiful CEO!
From then on, he ruled the city, crushed the petty and wicked, and embarked on the tyrannical journey of an urban legend!
taming-beasts-in-the-apocalypse-wait-i-h:
Sleep and kiss your ass goodbye.
The world had been cursed with a strange phenomenon... Do not sleep. An apocalypse where sleeping meant dying except you happen to have abundant grace, in other words superpowers.
The moment you fall asleep, you are transported into another world... a dangerous beast world where humans are treated as medicines to boost cultivation.
Die there... and you die in reality.
After awakening a Beast Taming system, Bai Xue Yao should have gained an advantage. Instead, her ability came with a strange condition.
[Tame an SSS beastman. Bear his pups to secure your reign in his tribe.]
[Negotiation denied.]
[Refusal means defying the almighty will of the system and all abilities will be locked.]
[Stubborness means hosts will lose the beast taming system and become food for the beasts.]
[Be good... and enjoy your reign]
Face with a condition she cannot refused. Bai Xue Yao must survive in two worlds, she must fight, adapt, and tame powerful beasts while dealing with a system that makes no sense.
Because in this world, the strong rules, and the weak becomes food.
taming-my-monster-girl-harem-from-scratc:
A world where taming monsters is the mainstream to survive. Cloud, an orphan from the slums, suddenly recovered his memories of a previous life. A man living on modern Earth, and an avid fan of sexy monster girls.
Running away from the constraints of his current life and starting anew, he decided to throw away his name and live as just “Will”.
tensei-shite-inaka-de-slowlife-wo-okurit:
The protagonist, Inaka Yuuji, was run over by a truck because his awareness was dulled from overworking.
“Ahー, with this I don’t have to work so much anymore. I want to spend my next life leisurely……”
was the wish Yuuji blurted out. He met God and it was decided that he will be reincarnated in the countryside of the otherworld. He became Alfred Slowlet, 2nd son of a countryside noble. Will he be able to enjoy and leisurely spend his slow life in the countryside?
the-cheat-emperor-of-the-culinary-world:
Fu Yu awoke from a big dream, feeling like the heavens stuffed his mouth with a pie.
Everything familiar suddenly became virtual.
The work kitchen, the tools he used, the colleagues he cooperated with, and the customers he faced.
Everyone and everything has become walking NPCs and auxiliary tools.
Daily life and work have turned into main quests that need to be completed and key clues for advancement.
A customer ordered a dish of loose sautéed meat slices.
Fu Yu took out a piece of fresh tenderloin: [Pork: Freshness: 90%]
Held an egg in one hand: [Egg: Freshness: 85%]
Heated oil in the pot, prepared starch, and got ready onions, ginger, and garlic.
First frying, then stir-frying; the meat is cooked and taken out of the pot, plated and served to the customer: [Ding! Task of one portion of loose sautéed meat slices completed. Reward received: Cooking Experience +10, RMB +100, one oil-draining spatula!]
As a chef constantly fed by the heavens, as long as he cooks, he levels up!
the-cheat-who-can-see-stats:
Matt Kershaw made £5,000 every time he put the ball out for a corner.
At 23, he was caught and banned from football for 7 years. Now he's 30, the ban is over, and he lifts crates in a warehouse in a northern town that still remembers the back pages.
Then his laptop dies in the middle of a football management game, and something downloads into his head.
Now there's a card over every footballer he looks at: stars, a standout number, and every other attribute locked. Quests appear that he never asked for.
An old teammate offers him a job coaching the defence at a part-time club up the valley. The owner wants goals conceded cut from 2.3 a game to 1. The squad knows exactly who he is: a cheat.
Matt can read a game better than anyone in the league, and he can't tell a single soul how.
And a man who once sold corners can't afford to look careless ever again.
***
Inspired by FOOTBALL MANAGEMENT SIMULATOR
the-devouring-knight:
Lumberling, a 42-year-old civil engineer, grew numb to the monotonous rhythm of modern life. Hoping to rekindle his sense of wonder, he set out on a solitary nature trip, only to stumble upon an ancient, forgotten pyramid. A strange red light burst forth, killing him instantly… and binding itself to his soul.
Cast adrift in the void, his soul found no rest, until he awoke in the body of a young foot soldier, bleeding and broken on a war-torn battlefield in a world not his own.
Determined not to die again, Lumberling fights to survive in this brutal new realm where knights clash with monsters, kingdoms rise and fall, and mysterious powers shape the fate of nations.
Armed with a strange ability to devour the essence of those he slays, he begins to carve out a new path, one forged by blood, strength, and sheer will.
But power alone may not be enough. In a world where danger lurks in every shadow, and ancient forces stir in the dark, can a lost soul rise above fate… or will he be consumed by the very essence he seeks to control?
the-first-legendary-beast-master:
Born into a dirt poor mining family, Karl only had one chance to get ahead in life, the annual elite recruitment day. On their final day of middle school, every student in the Golden Dragon Nation was given an experimental injection to awaken their affinity with magic.
Those few who succeeded would become the Elite, the leaders and idols of the nation, blessed with incredible magical powers and respected by all. Those who did not would return to their normal lives of hard work and low wages, just doing the best they could.
But with the nation surrounded by enemies, both humans and monsters, how long would these peaceful days of magical idols last?
Follow the story of Karl as he awakens a unique power and strives to become the world's first Legendary Beast Master.
the-full-leveled-healer-transmigrates-to:
Gu Yanfei was reborn. In her last life, it was only after her death that she realized she was the real daughter in a story about a real and a fake rich daughter. She was supposed to be the daughter of a nobleman, but someone switched her with another child at birth and left her leading a wretched life — a cannon fodder from start to finish. The female lead was the fake rich daughter, but she was also blessed with good fortune and the affection of the Gu family, taking everything that was rightfully Gu Yanfei’s.
In that life, Gu Yanfei lived as she died, with no rhyme or reason. However, after her death, she transmigrated to a cultivators’ realm and became a healer… But after cultivating herself for 200 years, she failed her ascension trials. Then, one of the divine thunderbolts struck her and sent her back to her last life — back to the moment when the identity of the rich daughter was exposed. Upon her return, everyone in the nobleman’s residence was laughing at her for being illiterate and uneducated, a far cry from the fake rich daughter blessed with good looks and a kind heart, who stood above the rest.…
the-great-demon-system:
In a world filled with abilities and superpowers, Moby Kane, a 16-year-old boy, is an orphan who is living his life with a little too much optimism, trying his best to get by.
Due to him having no ability, he had been bullied and tortured every day. However, for some odd reason, he never complained and always stayed happy no matter what. It was almost unnatural.
On one cruel day of immense pain, he realized that the world is a brutal, unforgiving place, making him regain his lost senses.
In his moment of desperation, a miracle happened.
the-rule-breaker-of-the-doomsday-game:
I woke up to a world where a zombie crisis had broken out; if nothing unexpected happened, I should have... become the world's strongest BOSS, the Zombie Dominator.
But the unexpected did happen; an entity named the “Doomsday Game” descended with a group of survivors.
A certain reborn survivor, using his foreknowledge, wanted to seize the SSS-rank talent, Devouring Evolution, from me, the Zombie Dominator.
The plan was sound, it's just that he came a bit too early and ran into me, who had yet to become a zombie.
Then, the reborn survivor was counter-killed by me, and that tiny step I was from becoming the Zombie Dominator was also kicked back for becoming a rule-breaker of the Doomsday Game.
...
“As a zombie, I am the big BOSS. So if I don't become a zombie, why can't I also be the big BOSS?” Qi Suian said.
the-unvanquished-child-of-nihility:
Morca, a mere mortal who dared to ascend to the heavens and claim his place among the so-called gods, ultimately failed. Not because of his own weakness, but because he was forced to watch his beloved little brother be slain by the Heavenly Titan Court’s envoy.
In that moment of grief and distraction, the Heavenly Titan Court’s envoy, realizing they could not stop him through conventional means, placed upon him the Curse of Eternal Doom, a fate that ensured both the heavens and the abyssal realms would relentlessly pursue him until his existence was completely erased.
And it nearly worked. His soul teetered on the brink of annihilation, moments away from being extracted.
Then, everything turned blank.
===
Morca, after 'transmigrating' into the world of Eden, awakened a powerful system that granted him a unique SSS+ talent. This talent allowed him to grow stronger through battle and killing. With the system’s aid, he advanced rapidly, eventually ascending into the Oblivion Realm–a place beyond the known and the unknown. There, he uncovered a great secret that no one had ever imagined existed.
During his journey to power, he met Neo Laura, a companion bound to him by the system.…
ugly-fat-and-vicious-my-five-beast-husba:
After dying in the apocalypse, Su Luoluo transmigrated into a Beast World novel.
She became the female lead's vicious foil. As the real heiress, she should have had everything. Instead, she was dark-skinned, overweight, and burdened with a prominent birthmark, while the fake heiress was beautiful, kind, and beloved by all.
Out of sheer spite, she snatched away the five Beast Husbands originally betrothed to the fake heiress. Unfortunately, melons picked by force were never sweet. None of the five Beast Husbands could stand her.
Su Luoluo shrugged. “If they don't like me, then let them be. I can shine on my own.”
[Ding! Congratulations, Host, on successfully binding the Love-Struck Strategy System. Turn all five Beast Husbands into love-struck devotees, and you'll receive generous rewards.]
Su Luoluo immediately perked up and said, “If you want me to make them fall head over heels for me, then I need to become beautiful first. System, make me pretty!”
[Sorry. This service is not available.]
“You want me to seduce five men who despise me — looking like THIS?”
The system firmly believed that beauty was not required to make someone fall hopelessly in love.…
unlimited-skill-points-system:
Jiaang Lin, a man who died saving someone, wakes up in a new world atop the Flame Beast Plain within the Profound Fire Kingdom. Greeted by the Infinite Skill Points System, he embarks on a quest to become the strongest.
With memories of his past life and newfound abilities, he quickly upgrades his skills to maximum levels. But as a fiery giant wolf attacks, can Jiaang Lin truly rely on his system to survive and fulfill his ambitions?
versatile-mage-starting-with-the-white-t:
Lu Jun, while traveling in Bashu, casually purchased a White Tiger pendant, only to discover it was connected to the White Tiger Totem. This unexpected event forced him to traverse into the world of Versatile Mage, a parallel universe to Blue Star. In this realm, magic flourishes, and monsters run rampant. (The story is designed to be understood without prior knowledge of the original novel, with the setting gradually unfolding.)
Through the fusion of dual origins, Lu Jun awakens an innate dual-element talent and gains mastery over the never-before-seen Metal element.
In the face of monstrous invasions, humanity's precarious survival, and constant infighting, Lu Jun stands atop the Sacred City and declares resolutely:
“I am the King of the World. Who approves? Who opposes?”
“Even if I must bear the Abyss of Calamity and hold up the Sacred City single-handedly, I, Lu Jun, remain invincible in this world!”
“Sword, come!”
With a single strike, the seven Archangels are nailed to the city walls, a sight that shocks all. The bodies of seven Red Cardinals pave a road of blood and bone
